title: record_change_result input
description: Records how a change ended, as reported. The engine creates a post-change review when the change type requires one or the result failed. This tool never moves the change request to completed: the change owner confirms that on the page, because it is a person's act.

resultKey.description: From the change result value list, such as succeeded or rolled back.

note.description: A plain note on the result.

evidence.description: Links to proof, such as a test result. Each becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

examples.note: Deployed in the window, smoke test passed.
